question: In which of the following states is the Sambhar Lake located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sambhar Lake is **India’s largest inland salt lake.**
 
• It is located in the **Nagaur and Jaipur districts of Rajasthan.**
 
• It is surrounded on all sides by the Aravali hills.
 
• It is the source of most of **Rajasthan's salt production.**
 
• It has been designated as a Ramsar site.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **​**__Chilika Lake is the **largest saline water lake in India.**
 
• Vembanad Lake is the longest lake in India.
 
• Cholamu Lake is the highest lake in India.
 
• Wular Lake is the largest freshwater lake in India.
 
• __Rajasthan__
 
 
• Capital: Jaipur
 
• ​National Park: Darrah National Park, Desert National Park, Keoladeo National Park, Ranthambore National Park
 
• State Animal: Camel and Chinkara
 
• State Bird: Godawan
 
• State Tree: Khejri tree
 
• State Flower: Rohida
